name: intro-disclosure

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows a completed step, the active Dashboard step and a fully loaded preview photo.

tagline: A guided tour modal slides through app features with pictures.
summary: A two-column feature tour. Step cards down the left list the stops with short lines and ticks; the right side shows a large photo with the step title and full description laid over it, advanced by Next, Previous or the step cards.
appearance: A wide dark modal titled Feature Tour with a thin progress bar under its header. The left column stacks three step cards, each a bold title and a grey line, the active one outlined and finished ones carrying a small green tick. The right half is a large rounded photo under a dark gradient with white title and copy.
behaviour: Picking a step card or pressing Next slides the photo and copy sideways and moves the progress bar; visited steps get ticks. Arrow keys step back and forward, and Skip all or Done closes the modal.
demo_content: Three steps: Welcome to the App, Explore the Dashboard, Collaborate with Your Team, over gradient and laptop photos.
search_phrases: guided tour of a new app
show users around on first visit
use_when: First-time visitors need a short guided walk through a few features, with pictures and next buttons.
avoid_when: It is a blocking modal that covers the app until skipped or finished, so it is wrong for repeat visits.
customise: Pass a steps array with titles, short and full descriptions, optional action and media, plus featureId and open state. The header title Feature Tour is fixed.
weight_why: A dialog with large photos and slide transitions, one step mounted at a time.

a11y.note: Focus is trapped and arrow keys work, but nothing checks prefers-reduced-motion for the slide transitions.

issues: Frames 2, 4 and 5 catch the photo mid-transition, leaving the right half blank or ghosted.
The progress bar has no accessible value or label beyond its visual fill.
polish_why: Balanced two-column tour with clear step cards; blank transition frames read as loading.
title: Intro Disclosure
